$comment: Copy to ~/.asm/skill-map.overrides.json and edit. Keys are skill ids as the Skill tool names them (globs allowed). Fields: triggers (strong phrases), weak (single tokens, two hits needed), patterns (regex on the prompt), paths (globs on Write/Edit file_path), commands (regex on Bash command), cwd (globs; requires_cwd makes cwd a precondition), not_for, reason, defer_to (drop when the named skill also matched), hint:false (never suggest), drop (remove auto-derived triggers). Then run: node ~/.asm/hooks/asm-skill-router.js --build
